test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: AB is parallel to CD. A transversal PQ intersects AB and CD at E and F, respectively, and ∠PEB = 56°. G is a point between AB and CD such that ∠BEG = 32° and ∠GFE = 47°. What is the measure of ∠EGF?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

∠BEF = 180° − ∠PEB = 180° − 56° = 124° (Linear pair)

∠GEF = ∠BEF − ∠BEG = 124° − 32° = 92°

In ▵EGF, sum of angles = 180°

∠EGF = 180° − (∠GEF + ∠GFE) = 180° − (92° + 47°) = 41°

**∴ The correct answer is 41°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **AB || CD**, **transversal PQ** intersects them at **E** and **F**. **∠PEB = 56°**, **∠BEG = 32°**, and **∠GFE = 47°**.

**Formula Used:** Linear pair property (sum = 180°) and Angle Sum Property of a triangle (sum = 180°).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21336634dfba58e0dee75adbbf3b46c458b1026b3ada460dbda6252dfd3093f1.png] 

⇒ Since **PQ** is a straight line, **∠PEB + ∠BEF = 180°** (Linear pair)

⇒ 56° + ∠BEF = 180°

⇒ ∠BEF = 180° − 56° = 124°

⇒ From the figure, **∠BEF = ∠BEG + ∠GEF**

⇒ 124° = 32° + ∠GEF

⇒ ∠GEF = 124° − 32° = 92°

⇒ In **▵EGF**, **∠GEF + ∠GFE + ∠EGF = 180°**

⇒ 92° + 47° + ∠EGF = 180°

⇒ 139° + ∠EGF = 180°

⇒ ∠EGF = 180° − 139° = 41°

**∴ The correct answer is 41°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Parallel Lines and Transversals

When two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, corresponding angles are equal, and alternate interior angles are equal.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of the interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

Linear Pair Axiom

If a ray stands on a line, then the sum of two adjacent angles so formed is 180°.</p
